main_claim: Israel Adesanya picks Ian Machado Garry to upset Islam Makhachev at UFC 330 because he 'believes in magic'.
note: Topuria appears in one sentence recalling a past upset ('Justin Gaethje beating Ilia Topuria was a big upset'); the article is Adesanya's pick for Makhachev vs Garry, so source is the main content's speaker (Adesanya, a fighter) and the act is none_of_these because nobody does anything regarding Topuria.

main_claim: Daniel Rodriguez answered Donchenko's post-UFC Paris callout by posting it on Instagram with a middle-finger emoji.
note: 'Rodriguez responded on Instagram stories by sharing the callout with a middle-finger emoji' is a mocking reply to his callout; 'The UFC has not confirmed whether the matchup will be booked' keeps Rodriguez other_fighter_side and the fact a wish, no_fact. Centrality unsure: the piece is an exchange between the two with half the text on each, so main_subject is arguable; the Soriano win is only restated as background and his callout is described, not quoted.

main_claim: Donchenko's next fight is against Punahele Soriano at UFC Fight Night in Paris on 5 September.
note: 'Наступний поєдинок ... відбудеться 5 вересня на турнірі UFC Fight Night, який прийматиме Париж. Суперником українця стане ... Пунахеле Соріано' is stated flatly as a booking with nobody quoted. Unsure: a paragraph on Soriano's record could make it one_of_several; the embedded 'Допис, поширений Daniil DonchenKO' suggests his own post is the source (himself), and the article does not say who announced it, so reported is arguable for firmness.

main_claim: Manager Vladyslav Soroka explains in an interview how Ukrainian fighters are built up toward the UFC and which of them will get there soon.
note: Amosov gets one line of intro ('Наразі у рейтингу UFC перебуває Ярослав Амосов') and is never returned to; the article is an interview with Soroka, a manager of other fighters (KSW champion Yakymenko, BFL fighters, helper to Donchenko), so source is other_fighter_side for the main content and the act regarding Amosov is none_of_these.

main_claim: Ali Abdelaziz claims Usman Nurmagomedov can beat every top UFC lightweight and wants Ilia Topuria as Usman's UFC debut opponent.
note: 'The fight I want, if he goes to the UFC, I want Ilia Topuria, first fight' and 'I think he'll make Ilia quit' are another fighter's manager naming Topuria as the wanted opponent, and the article adds nothing new about Topuria, so only_mentioned per the callout rule. Unsure: Topuria is the headline wanted opponent with a section of his own (one_of_several arguable), and 'he'll make Ilia quit' could be read as assesses_him rather than a challenge.

main_claim: The tipster predicts Punahele Soriano will beat Daniil Donchenko on 5 September, at odds of 2.90.
note: 'Our prediction is that Soriano will win in 2.90' from the site's expert; the fight itself ('will face Daniil Donchenko on September 5') is the premise of the betting preview, so it is background and next fight stays no; both fighters get equal analysis, so one_of_several.

main_claim: Donchenko says he phoned his grandmother, who opposed his MMA career, after his knockout win to tell her he can earn good money from the sport.
note: 'Після бою подзвонив бабусі. Я сказав їй, що можу цим заробляти непогані гроші на життя' is his own quoted account of a family matter, so personal_life. The win is restated before the interview (result no); '5 вересня Донченко проведе поєдинок у Парижі проти ... Соріано' is a line the writer adds after the quote, which I read as background, though an editor could count it as a second fact and say yes.

main_claim: Donchenko meets Punahele Soriano on the UFC Fight Night 287 main card in Paris on 5 September, walking out around 23:00 Kyiv time, live on UFC Fight Pass and Setanta Sports+.
note: 'Попередні бої стартують о 19:00, основний кард заплановано на 22:00. Донченко та Соріано вийдуть в октагон орієнтовно о 23:00' is card order and start times, nobody speaking; the booking is restated as the premise of the watch guide, so next fight is no. Unsure: Soriano gets a line of record (one_of_several arguable) and an editor could call the restated booking next_fight instead of fight_week_event. The 'Українець завоював четверту звитягу' line and the rest are page furniture.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris for his fourth UFC win.
note: A round-by-round account ending 'Донченко впевнено забрав поєдинок, здобувши четверту перемогу під егідою UFC! ... UD 3 (30-27, 30-27, 29-28)', nobody quoted. Centrality unsure because a fight report necessarily covers both men, though it is framed as his win.

main_claim: Donchenko took part in the UFC event in Paris, appearing at the weigh-in ceremony, in the octagon and at the press conference.
note: 'Данило Донченко взяв участь у турнірі в Парижі, де продемонстрував свої навички на церемонії зважування, в октагоні та на прес-конференції' is the only concrete line; no outcome is given, so result is no. Unsure: the text is almost content-free, so no_fact is arguable, and since it is relayed 'Як повідомляє Sport.ua' an editor could pick reported over official_or_done.

main_claim: MMA Fighting's writers debate how big an upset Ian Machado Garry beating Islam Makhachev at UFC 330 would be, whether Mackenzie Dern is the true strawweight champion, and their undercard picks.
note: Amosov appears once, as background to an Alvarez fight ('Alvarez just recently fell to Yaroslav Amosov, which stopped his four-fight win streak'); the article is a journalists' roundtable, so source is media and the act regarding Amosov is none_of_these.

main_claim: Justin Gaethje says he will not return to the Octagon until 2027 because both hands are still hurt from his win over Topuria.
note: Topuria appears only as the fight Gaethje's hands were hurt in ('hand injuries suffered in his win over Ilia Topuria at UFC Freedom 250'), a past result recalled as background; Gaethje has fought him so he is opponent_side, but he says nothing about Topuria, so the act is none_of_these and the health news is Gaethje's, not his.

main_claim: Donchenko and Punahele Soriano faced off at the UFC Fight Night 287 ceremonial weigh-ins.
note: The only content is the title line 'Daniil Donchenko vs. Punahele Soriano, UFC Fight Night 287 ceremonial weigh-ins faceoff'; everything after it is site furniture (sign-up and password prompts). Unsure: with no body an editor could call him not_in_content and the fact no_fact; I took the title as the article's own claim of a two-man weigh-in faceoff.

main_claim: Islam Makhachev rates Prates, Morales and Rakhmonov as equal contenders, dismisses Yaroslav Amosov as not dangerous, and says Ian Machado Garry will be champion after he leaves.
note: 'I don't think [Amosov] is a dangerous opponent ... I don't consider him a dangerous fighter at all' is a new assessment of him by Makhachev, who is not booked against him, hence other_fighter_side and no_fact. Centrality unsure: he is one of several contenders Makhachev ranks, but the quoted dismissal is new content about him rather than a recap, so one_of_several over only_mentioned.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris, extending his UFC record to 4-0.
note: 'завершився одноголосним рішенням суддів на користь українця – 30:27, 30:27, 29:28', reported 'з посиланням на результати турніру' with the UFC's result tweet embedded. 'заявив про бажання провести свій наступний поєдинок проти ... Даніеля Родрігеса' is a wish, described not quoted, so next fight and he_speaks are no.
